name: BytePlus Searchinfinity
summary: Web and image search and static page fetch from BytePlus (ByteDance) Searchinfinity: Flux and Omnira search engines plus a Fetch API.

api_key.description: a Searchinfinity API key (Searchinfinity console > API Key). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Request and response fields are PascalCase (Query, Count, Result.WebResults...).
Postpaid credits at $0.006 each: Flux search 1 credit ($0.006) per request, Omnira search half a credit ($0.003), Fetch a sixth ($0.001).
Errors come back in ResponseMetadata.Error with numeric codes: 700901 invalid key, 700429 QPS exceeded, 10403 service not enabled or free quota exhausted, 10400 bad parameter.
All three calls are reads over POST.

endpoints.name: Search the web (Flux)
endpoints.summary: Ranked web results with snippet, ~300-500 character summary and publish time.

Query.description: Search query, at most 400 characters or 50 words; one query only.

Filter.description: Filters: Sites and BlockHosts (up to five full domains joined by |), Language (EN default, ZH-HANS, ZH-HANT).

TimeRange.description: OneDay, OneWeek, OneMonth, OneYear, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Blank means no limit.

notes: Read over POST. 1 credit ($0.006) per request; 30-second timeout.

endpoints.name: Search the web or images (Omnira)
endpoints.summary: Web documents with snippets and images, or image results with their source context.

Query.description: Search query. For web search it accepts site:domain and recency:N (days, 1-30) operators, e.g. 'financial news recency:1'.

DocCount.description: Documents or images to return, max 20 (default 10 for web, 5 for image).

MaxSnippetLength.description: Web only: max snippet length, default 300, max 3000.

MaxImageCountPerDoc.description: Web only: images per document, default 1, max 10.

ImageFilter.description: Image only: ShortEdgePixelMin, ShortEdgePixelMax, AspectRatioMin, AspectRatioMax (height/width).

notes: Read over POST. Half a credit ($0.003) per request.

endpoints.name: Fetch a page's text
endpoints.summary: Title, publish time and up to 50,000 characters of body text of one URL.

Url.description: One http(s) URL; arrays are not accepted.

notes: Read over POST. A sixth of a credit ($0.001) per request; 60-second timeout.
Static HTML only (no JavaScript). The target page's own status is Result.Data.StatusCode, separate from API errors. Fetches obey robots rules.
